claims: "Wahoos" or "Hoos" are the popular nicknames for the University of Virginia (UVA) Cavaliers sports teams and students.
"Wahoos" or "Hoos" are derived from a derisive nickname used by rival fans in the 1890s.
The University of Virginia later adopted the derisive nickname.
The term originated from the "Wa-hoo-wa" victory yell.
The term originated in the 1890s as a mocking chant from Washington and Lee University fans.
The mocking chant referred to UVA students as "rowdy Wahoos".
By the 1940s, UVA students fully embraced the nickname.
UVA students later shortened it to "Hoos".
"Wahoos" and "Hoos" are preferred by students, fans, and athletes.
The 10th-seeded Hoos defeated Iowa to advance to the Sweet 16 in March 2026.
The Virginia women's swim team won their sixth consecutive NCAA Championship in March 2026.
The Virginia women's swim team scored 589 points.
